absent: Exact byte layout, field order, sizes, alignment and padding of maple node variants, maple enode, traversal cursor, write cursor and maple tree.
Pivot, slot and gap capacities, node sizing, maximum depth, and split, coalesce, balancing and deficit handling.
Required lock types, acquisition contexts, ordering and sleeping constraints for write, reservation and allocation paths beyond presence of validation checks.
Internals of write preparation, demand calculation, bulk node allocation, spanning multi node modification and RCU safe replacement.
Meaning and persistence of allocation flags, error pointer encoding, trace points and debug build effects.
Forward scan setup and slot iteration helpers and any helpers not routed to this lane.

findings.text: Parent link encoding uses value 0x01 to denote the tree root.
Parent slot index uses shift 0x03 with mask 0xF8, while the compact sixteen byte form uses shift 0x02 with mask 0xFC.
Range flavour tags use value 0x06 for sixty four bit ranges and value 0x02 for thirty two bit ranges, with a distinct not sixteen bit range marker also value 0x02.

Cyclic allocation locates a single free position inside caller bounds guided by a persistent hint with wrap to the lower bound, installs the supplied entry with memory pressure retry, and maintains start, successor hint and wrapped indication across rollover.
Forward empty area search validates the requested window and length and on success positions the cursor over a usable extent of that length, otherwise reports invalid request or absence of space.

Reverse empty area search validates the requested window and length and on success positions the cursor over a usable extent anchored toward the upper end, otherwise reports invalid request or absence of space.
Stored write family covers direct store, store with prior reservation, and separate reservation, with lock validation and accounting of node demand plus a flag recording successful preallocation.
Forward iteration yields the next occupied entry within an upper bound, with a tree level convenience wrapper that holds read side protection across the cursor operation.
Backward iteration yields a prior entry above a lower bound, optionally accepting vacant coverage, with a tree level convenience wrapper that holds read side protection across the cursor operation.
Bounded forward find returns the next occupied entry up to a caller maximum and leaves the cursor in active state when the scan completes.
Pause detaches the cursor from tree memory while preserving logical position for later reactivation.
Lookup and allocation descent select the first pivot covering the sought index and proceed toward leaves, while dense encodings derive position arithmetically from the lower bound.
Insertion succeeds only into vacant coverage and otherwise reports already present, treating spanning coverage as conflicting and root handling as separate cases.
Allocation suitability within a node comes from stored per slot totals when available, otherwise from observed vacancy clipped to the active window.
Sibling and node skipping moves fail at tree edges and otherwise reposition through the parent before descending into the adjacent subtree.
Empty and singleton trees satisfy area and walk requests without descending, with zero receiving dedicated handling.
Pivot modification applies only to sixty four bit range style nodes and has no effect for copy like encodings, with the pivot position required to remain inside the type specific bound.
Tree level forward and backward iteration run inside read side critical sections, while dead subtree reclamation dereferences child links only with callback protection asserted.
Write, reservation, pause and cursor iteration entries validate locking discipline before acting on tree state.

Traversal cursor logically carries sought interval, allowed window, current node, slot offset, lifecycle status, write intent and allocation demand, while nodes expose type dependent pivot, slot and gap vectors with parent linkage.

Cursor lifecycle spans start, active, pause, none, underflow, overflow, root and error, steering setup of forward and backward searches toward activation, rewalk or orderly termination based on bounds.
Write intent distinguishes ordinary leaf change from root replacement, fresh root creation and multi node spanning cases.
Cyclic allocation keeps a wrapped marker that is cleared when a wrapped allocation is consumed and set when the successor hint rolls over.
Observation of reclaimed nodes during lookup or backward movement abandons the walk and either resets to safety or rewalks from a saved point with retry.
Malformed windows and empty sizes are rejected as invalid, occupation of present coverage reports already present, and lack of usable space or scan exhaustion reports busy.
Deferred subtree destruction walks to the extreme leaf then releases slot vectors level by level upward before freeing the terminal node.
Debug builds treat a cursor whose start lies beyond its end as invalid and record an error before any modification.
